title: Meeting Calendar Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(organizer) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many meeting calendar event events land each day and how many distinct organizer values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest meeting calendar event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct organizer values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much meeting calendar event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
